description: an http client request emits socket on the tick after its socket is assigned, while it is still connecting (a reused one already connected), and a response whose socket goes back to its agent (keepAlive, or a finite maxSockets) has res.socket null after Node's own first end listener, once the request has finished writing; req.destroy() before a response is a socket hang up, and a request still writing closes when the server ends the connection after an early response, as Node 22
